# Product v0.1 synthetic regression fixture

`flows.csv` contains 12 fully synthetic CICFlowMeter-compatible rows generated by [`tools/generate_product_fixture.py`](../../../tools/generate_product_fixture.py). It reads no UNSW/CIC input and uses documentation-only IP ranges (`192.0.2.0/24` and `198.51.100.0/24`), artificial 2026 timestamps, explicit numeric profiles, and synthetic Flow IDs.

The fixture covers same-timestamp peer exclusion, multiple hosts and Policy B keys, TCP and UDP, alert and non-alert scores, a multi-flow/multi-protocol promoted incident, and a second incident after a gap greater than 300 seconds.

`expected-incidents.jsonl` is promoted-only `incident-v1` output from the exact public `context-rf-v2` artifact. Public incident scores are serialized at 12 decimal places so sub-tolerance platform noise cannot change JSONL bytes; detector decisions still use the unrounded scores. `expected-run.json` freezes hashes, counts, scores with an absolute tolerance of `1e-12`, incident membership, versions, and operational policy.

These files are regression evidence, not an accuracy benchmark. Goldens must never be rewritten automatically after a failure; any update requires an explicit human-reviewed contract change.
